status: Declared before executing the newly specified menu-selection and internal-validation experiments; research only.
scope: Static annual fixed-target frontiers, joint menu selection and suitability/stability; no final-policy selection or report generation.
prior_exposure: V1 final evaluation 121–180 has already been seen. This is exploratory redevelopment and internal scenario validation, not a fresh blind test.
market_loading: safeinvest.data.load_paths with IDs 1–120 only and allow_final=False

candidate_family.policy: fixed target restored before each annual return, initial allocation charged, no terminal liquidation

objective: Mean annualized log net real terminal growth, subject to empirical full-horizon P(MDD>L)<=alpha within each training sample. This is a sample constraint, not certified population risk.
liquidity_interpretation: Sensitivity policy assumptions, not calibrated withdrawal needs. Risk-only results do not fully resolve the liquidity questionnaire. Actual modeled market has no withdrawals or distinct settlement constraints.

menu_selection.feasibility: Empirical exceedance count/n<=alpha with 1e-12 numerical comparison tolerance, and target bill weight>=declared case floor.
menu_selection.client_choice: Highest training expected annualized log growth among feasible menu products; exact numerical growth ties prefer lower expected excess MDD, then lower CVaR90 at that client H, then candidate index.
menu_selection.oracle: Each client training-sample best feasible fixed target, used only as a regret benchmark; never offered outside the common menu.
priority: maximize count of the five representative clients covered
minimize maximum annualized log-growth regret among covered clients
minimize mean annualized log-growth regret among covered clients
menu_selection.interpretation: Coverage/fairness/efficiency priorities are normative product-design decisions. The five profiles are not population frequencies.
menu_selection.minimum_identified_menu: Compare best m=1,2,3. Use the smallest m matching the 3-slot objective within 1e-12 numerical tolerance. A missing third demand-identified product is explicitly acknowledged.
menu_selection.extension_slots: Fill any remaining slots from the H=15 growth–CVaR90 Pareto frontier by maximum minimum absolute CVaR90 separation from existing products; if none exist start at minimum CVaR. Ties prefer higher mean log growth then lower candidate index. This is a stated breadth policy, not a preference identified by the five profiles.
menu_selection.reference_horizon_reason: Median of the five supplied horizons, not an estimated population horizon.
menu_selection.labels: Conservative/Balanced/Growth sorted by H15 CVaR90, with growth then candidate index tie breaks. Check loss/growth ordering at all five horizons and disclose crossings.
menu_selection.dominance_pruning: Only remove a target when a lower-index target is componentwise no worse in all feasible profile growth scores, with a strict improvement beyond numerical tolerance, or when exact equivalent scores have a lower index. This preserves canonical menu ties.
menu_selection.degeneracy: Do not fill an extension slot using an indistinguishable reference risk level. Retain incomplete/tied-risk flags rather than manufacturing three economically distinct products.

statistics.cvar: Variational/fractional-tail average across complete-path MDD outcomes; not time-pooled CDaR.
statistics.risk_event: MDD>L+1e-12 numerical guard; not an extra economic risk allowance.
severity: expected excess MDD above client L
statistics.ordinary_risk: within-path annual real net return sample SD, then across-path summaries

validation.test_fold_use: Refit the entire menu on 96 training paths, freeze that fold menu/assignments, evaluate on its 24 test paths without adjustment.
validation.aggregation: OOF summaries describe the selection procedure with overlapping training sets, not iid evaluation of one final fixed rule. No naive pooled CP certificate.
validation.reviewed_profiles: Report assignment/referral count and denominator separately. Do not manufacture human-adviser returns or silently omit reviewed cases in coverage claims.

stability.meaning: Sampling/configuration/assignment stability conditional on empirical scenarios, not a population risk certificate.
stability.main_case: alpha .10 and risk_only; other policy cases may use 400 replicates with counts recorded.
stability.neighborhood: L1 target-weight distance<=.10, excluding self, preserving declared constraints; report range and eligibility changes.
stability.classification: Separate policy-sensitive (case changes), sample-unstable (fold/bootstrap changes), sample-infeasible (no menu feasible), and sample-supported. Report proportions rather than hiding them behind an unvalidated hard stability cutoff.

flags.boundary_pass: k=floor(n*alpha); one additional breach would reverse screening
flags.boundary_fail: k=floor(n*alpha)+1; one fewer breach would reverse screening
flags.policy_sensitive: Report product/weight changes separately from automatic-versus-review changes across alpha and reserve cases.
flags.sampling_sensitive: Training folds disagree on auto/review, or full-development assignment is one-scenario-boundary pass.
flags.internal_calibration_warning: Among test paths with fold-frozen automatic assignments, OOF empirical breach proportion exceeds the stated alpha. This is a diagnostic, not a population hypothesis-test conclusion.
flags.development_consistent_auto: Full-development sample passes away from one-path boundary, all five training fits assign automatically, and OOF empirical breach rate is <=alpha. No formal risk certification is claimed.
flags.consistent_referral: Full-development and all five folds refer the profile.
flags.parameter_vs_function: Unstable weights with stable assignment/regret are parameter nonidentification, not automatically functional failure.

predeclared_sensitivity.grid_role: Resolution diagnostic; main interpretable 5pp-grid remains the reference, no choosing resolution by best returns.
predeclared_sensitivity.cost_role: Hold fitted main menu fixed first; report any reselected-menu comparison separately.
predeclared_sensitivity.severity_alternative: CVaR_(1-alpha)(MDD)<=L as stronger policy case if studied; not an equivalent questionnaire meaning.
predeclared_sensitivity.grid_scope: Primary resolution comparison refits within the union of L1<=.10 neighborhoods of the main selected coarse targets on a .025 lattice. The full fine grid may be described, but does not replace the primary method by backtest performance.

prohibited_interpretations: forecast resampling creates independent market scenarios
three menu labels alone establish ordering at every horizon
risk-only screen fully settles liquidity suitability
development_history: The 1–120 development data were already used by V1 and are being described in a concurrent asset/liquidity audit. This is prospective specification of a new selection procedure, not preregistration on wholly unseen data.

fixed_comparator.name: H15 frontier endpoints and middle-risk representative
fixed_comparator.construction: Training-only growth–CVaR90 Pareto frontier; minimum-risk endpoint, maximum-growth endpoint, then distinct frontier point nearest their risk midpoint.
fixed_comparator.role: Predeclared descriptive alternative; do not replace the primary coverage/regret method merely because one result looks better.
fixed_comparator.ties: Higher growth, then lower risk, then candidate index; flag fewer than three distinct risk levels.
